pm:coupling.pm:observed: across four quarters, each additional delivery engineer reduced out-of-hours escalations by roughly a fifth of a person on the rota; the two months the delivery teams ran two under establishment are the two months the rota overran. NEITHER MEMBER COULD OBSERVE THIS: neither files the rota.

the same planners schedule delivery work and the shift line. Across six quarters, the two quarters the delivery teams ran under establishment are the two quarters the line's schedule slipped, with no change to the line itself. Relieving delivery headcount visibly reduced the line's remainder, which is what a stack of independent quantizations is assumed not to do.

pm:coupling.pm:observed: US inference above the reserved eight cards is routed to the Lisbon reservation, so the Portuguese layer's clearance falls when the US layer's demand peaks. Observed on the routing logs, not on either filing.

asrt:fusion.asrt:name: labour
asrt:fusion.asrt:observed: one delivery team under two employers. The queue is shared, work is assigned by skill rather than by entity, and either side has picked up the other's backlog within a week on eleven occasions this year. ⚠️ Fungibility is not total: language and the eight-hour offset make the Lisbon side unusable for US on-call, which is why `on-call` is a separate layer rather than part of this one.
